# Welcome

This booklet collects the workshop-oriented chapters for the
DIY-QuantiFluorONE-dsDNA-Fluorometer project.

The current draft includes:

- Hardware and Assembly
- Getting Started: Basic Operation and Menu Navigation
- Calibration Suite Web App
- Installing CircuitPython, the Bootloader, and Firmware

Additional theory, software-installation, calibration, and analytical chapters
can be added incrementally to the same booklet structure.
